This Game has some fantastic PVP traits that I really enjoy and the gun customisation is industry standard as far as I am concerned. I've had some fantastic PVP in this game but there are some significant issues that I find distract from it:|

- Art style and changes: I am unsure if I am just no longer the target demographic (and therefore they are focusing on non-western markets), but the games art style and focus is just weird. I don't care about zombies. I don't care about weird cross-overs with  Cyberpunk - I like a grounded extraction shooter that has sim elements - a few steps down from what tarkov is. Whilst there is still this, several of the recent steps in the art direction and game direciton make it feel very confused and not something that that I relate to. Unsure if this is just because this is what is desired within asian markets.

- The monetisation is absolutely rancid and predatory. I have no problems with supporting a game through microtransactions if it is free, but this requires the ongoing use gambling mechanics that generate neglible returns. Its possibly the worst implementation of microtransactions I have ever seen. If you want something that is easy, accessible - look at the Finals as a model. Its also incredibly hard to get access to the things you actually want - 70 Australian dollars for a skin? Yeah no thanks bro.

- The cosmetics are rubbish: Even if I do manage to try and get access to some of the cosemetics, they are completely meh. Where are the grounded operator skins or weapon skins? I actually rather keep the weapons as vanillabecause of this.

- The UI: THe gun customisation and UI in so many ways is industry leading, but other areas is really average. What are all these events? why do I randomly get gifted currency? I just absentmindedly click through them to get money and have no reason to care otherwise. Multiple sub menus are average.

If you can deal with the above, then you have a good shooter. I myself have just found over time the art style and monetisation have pushed me away to go play games like Gray Zone Warfare as opposed to something like this. I hope this changes!

**Arena Breakout: Infinite — How to Turn a Potentially Great Game into Absolute Garbage.**

It's honestly unbelievable how badly you can ruin a game that originally had so much potential. Arena Breakout: Infinite is a perfect example of how developers can take an interesting hardcore shooter and turn it into a complete Chinese-made disaster.

**Balance? Apparently, nobody even bothered to test it. Game design? It feels like decisions are made completely at random. Logic behind the gameplay mechanics? Forget about it.**

Instead of building on the game's strengths, fixing existing issues, and actually listening to the community, the developers seem determined to bury their own project.

Every gaming session feels less like fighting other players and more like fighting the developers' terrible decisions. And the most frustrating part is that none of this feels like the challenge of a well-designed hardcore shooter. It's just plain bad game design.

A game like this should reward tactics, experience, and smart decision-making — not constantly leave players wondering, "Who the hell thought this was a good idea?"

**Arena Breakout: Infinite isn't becoming harder or more interesting. It's becoming dumber, more frustrating, and increasingly pointless.**

It's amazing how you can have a solid concept, good technical foundations, and an interested player base — and still manage to screw everything up so spectacularly.

The developers need to stop pretending everything is going according to plan and actually start fixing their game. Because right now, this isn't a serious competitor to other tactical shooters. It's just a poorly balanced mess filled with questionable design choices.

**Final verdict: Another disappointment straight off the Chinese gaming assembly line. A game that could have been great but has managed to sink straight to rock bottom.**

**Absolutely NOT recommended. Don't waste your time, patience, or sanity on this garbage.**
